Using \(\log(x^{3}) = 3\log(x)\):

\[
\int -3\log(x^{3})\,dx
= \int -9\log(x)\,dx
\]

Since \(\int \log(x)\,dx = x\log(x) - x\), we get:

\[
-9*(x\log(x) - x) + C
= -9*x\log(x) + 9*x + C
\]

Equivalently, in terms of \(\log(x^{3})\):

<answer>-3*x*log(x**3) + 9*x + C</answer>
